title: Heilbronn
description: A wine town on the Neckar with a fast-growing technology campus and a strong regional industry.
html:
Wine, industry and a new campus

Heilbronn, an hour north of Stuttgart, has two faces. The old one is the wine town on the Neckar, surrounded by vineyards, with a market square and a long literary tradition. The new one is the education campus that a local foundation has built on former industrial land, which has drawn a technical university, a business school and a growing number of start-ups to the city in a few years.

Studying and working here

The city's university of applied sciences is strong in engineering, business and IT, and the campus now also hosts programmes from one of Germany's leading technical universities, several in English. The region is home to a discount retail giant and a cluster of mid-sized manufacturers, so internships and first jobs are close by. With about 130,000 residents the city is manageable and rents are moderate; Stuttgart is 45 minutes away by train.
